text: The due-diligence file from June 2025 stating no loss was detected on the property is no longer valid. According to the latest observation from November 2026, there has been a tree-cover loss event in 2025 affecting 13.5 hectares, which is approximately 3.91% of the asset. This change was detected using the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) and corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset, with 98% of the event area confirmed as forest in 2020.
